content.snl: def-hyp(list-partial(Type.judge(@F, Analysis.PFun), Type.judge(@x, Real)), list-partial(Analysis.contLeftAt(F, x), Analysis.contRightAt(F, x)), Logic.and(Set.mem(x, Analysis.domain(F)), Analysis.limLeft(F, @y, x, Type.apply(Analysis.map(F), x))))

values.en: Left-continuity at `x₀` asks that the left limit exist and equal `F.map x₀`; right-continuity uses the right limit. `F` is continuous at `x₀` iff it is both left- and right-continuous there.
values.zh-CN: 在 `x₀` 处左连续，要求左极限存在并等于 `F.map x₀`；右连续则使用右极限。`F` 在 `x₀` 处连续，当且仅当它在那里既左连续又右连续。
